resources.string: Stage edits in a read-only local stdio session (io.cache=true). Review them in Project → Patches. The project remembers this setting, not the pending patches.
Cached editing requires a local binary and cannot be combined with writable or debug startup flags.
Could not start a read-only session with the write cache enabled.
Cached editing requires an active write cache and a read-only binary. Reopen the project to restore this mode.
%1$s may have pending patches. Continuing discards them. To keep them, cancel and export a patched copy or write the patches to the file from Patches.
Saving analysis does not save pending patches. You can keep the session open after saving to export them or write them to the file.
Pending patches from the previous session were not restored.
This action would replace a write-cache session. Export or write any pending patches from Patches, then open the binary without write cache to debug it.
